prompt: Build a 4-qubit circuit implementing, as a general-purpose circuit block: Hadamard on all 4 qubits, then the phase exp(-i*gamma*H) where H = 0.4 * Z0 * Z1 + 0.6 * Z1 * Z2 * Z3 (one two-body term plus one three-body term). gamma = 0.5. Any correct implementation is accepted (each term is diagonal, so any gate sequence producing the correct combined phase per computational basis state is correct — it does not need to match one specific decomposition). No measurement.
